_purpose: Documentation of every mart_* table and column (replaces PostgreSQL COMMENT ON). Loaded into semantic_table_doc / semantic_column_doc by build_warehouse.py; every mart column must be documented here or the build fails.

common_columns.fy: Financial year Apr-Mar as text, e.g. '2024-25'. FY 2025-26 holds only 1-30 Apr 2025 (data ends 30-Apr-2025).
common_columns.fy_start_date: First day (1 April) of the financial year.
common_columns.fy_month_no: Month number within the FY: April = 1 ... March = 12.
common_columns.water_year: Hydro water year Jun-May as text, e.g. '2024-25'.
common_columns.wy_month_no: Month number within the water year: June = 1 ... May = 12.
common_columns.month_label: K-eRP month label in upper case, e.g. 'MAR-2025'.
common_columns.fy_quarter: Quarter of the financial year: 'Q1' = Apr-Jun, 'Q2' = Jul-Sep, 'Q3' = Oct-Dec, 'Q4' = Jan-Mar. Always pair with fy.
common_columns.days_in_month: Number of days in the calendar month.
common_columns.station_key: Station code, e.g. 'RTPS', 'SGS', 'KG-WEF' (the 'project' in K-eRP reports). Join mart_dim_station for the name.
common_columns.plant_category_label: HO dashboard category: THERMAL-COAL, MAJOR HYDRO, MINOR HYDRO, GAS, RES (waste to energy), SOLAR, WIND.
common_columns.plant_type_code: Coarse plant type: THERMAL, HYDRO, GAS, WTE, SOLAR, WIND.
common_columns.capacity_mu: Energy the unit(s) could produce in the period at full capacity: capacity_mw x 24 / 1000 per unit-day, summed. Denominator of PLF and PAF.
common_columns.gross_gen_mu: Gross generation in MU (million kWh). Additive.
common_columns.aux_consumption_mu: Auxiliary consumption in MU. At station level includes common auxiliary (always 0 in this data).
common_columns.unit_aux_mu: Unit auxiliary consumption summed over the station's units, MU.
common_columns.common_aux_mu: Station common auxiliary consumption, MU. Not loaded in this data, so always 0.
common_columns.net_export_mu: Net export = gross generation - auxiliary consumption, MU.
common_columns.deemed_gen_mu: NLD: deemed generation lost to no-load-demand back-down, MU. Used for 'PLF with NLD'.
common_columns.declared_capacity_mu: Declared capacity (availability) in MU. PAF = declared_capacity_mu / capacity_mu x 100.
common_columns.peak_load_mw: Highest load of the day (unit), MW. At month grain: the highest daily peak. Never sum.
common_columns.running_hrs: Running (service) hours. Above unit grain this is unit-hours summed over units, not clock hours.
common_columns.forced_outage_hrs: Forced outage hours (unit-hours when summed over units).
common_columns.planned_outage_hrs: Planned outage / maintenance hours (unit-hours when summed over units).
common_columns.rsd_hrs: Reserve shut-down hours: unit available but not required (for hydro, idle hours). Unit-hours when summed.
common_columns.coal_consumed_mt: Coal consumed, tonnes (thermal only; NULL for other plants).
common_columns.hfo_consumed_kl: Heavy fuel oil consumed, kL (thermal only).
common_columns.ldo_consumed_kl: Light diesel oil consumed, kL (thermal only).
common_columns.gas_consumed_mmscm: Natural gas consumed, million standard cubic metres (YCCPP only).
common_columns.msw_consumed_mt: Municipal solid waste consumed, tonnes (BWTEP only).
common_columns.gcv_coal_kcal_kg: Gross calorific value of coal fired that day, kcal/kg. Never AVG across rows: weight by coal_consumed_mt.
common_columns.gcv_oil_kcal_l: Gross calorific value of oil, kcal/litre.
common_columns.gross_heat_rate_kcal_kwh: Gross heat rate that day, kcal/kWh. Never AVG across rows: weight by gross_gen_mu. Meaningless on near-zero generation days (see is_ratio_outlier).
common_columns.water_used_mcft: Hydro: water let out for generation, million cubic feet.
common_columns.is_ratio_outlier: 1 when generation was near zero but fuel was burnt, so heat rate / specific oil for that day are extreme (e.g. 263,995 kcal/kWh). Exclude (= 0) when ranking daily heat rate or specific oil.
common_columns.anchor_scope: Whether the row's total is pinned to the K-eRP document: 'document_day' (RTPS/SGS 06-Apr-2025), 'document_month_total' (RTPS/SGS Mar-2025), 'document_fy_total' (RTPS FY 2024-25), 'workbook_fy_estimate' (other stations, FY 2024-25 estimated from the HO report); NULL = synthetic.
common_columns.days_covered: Number of days with data in the row's period (smaller for units commissioned or data ending mid-period).
common_columns.units_reporting: Number of units that contributed to the station row.
common_columns.months_covered: Number of months with data in the FY row.
common_columns.is_partial_period: 1 when the FY row does not cover the full year (FY 2025-26 = April 2025 only; commissioning years).
common_columns.max_day_gen_mu: Highest single-day generation in the period, MU (station: station-day total).
common_columns.max_day_gen_date: Date of max_day_gen_mu (NULL when nothing was generated).
common_columns.gcv_coal_x_coal_mt: Weighting helper: SUM(gcv_coal_kcal_kg x coal_consumed_mt). Weighted GCV = SUM(gcv_coal_x_coal_mt) / SUM(coal_mt_with_gcv).
common_columns.coal_mt_with_gcv: Weighting helper: coal tonnes on days that have a GCV value.
common_columns.heat_rate_x_gen_mu: Weighting helper: SUM(gross_heat_rate_kcal_kwh x gross_gen_mu). Weighted heat rate = SUM(heat_rate_x_gen_mu) / SUM(gen_mu_with_heat_rate).
common_columns.gen_mu_with_heat_rate: Weighting helper: gross MU on days that have a heat-rate value.
common_columns.cea_target_mu: CEA (Central Electricity Authority) monthly generation target, MU.
common_columns.plf_pct: Plant Load Factor % for this row = gross_gen_mu / capacity_mu x 100. Never AVG or SUM across rows: recompute SUM(gross_gen_mu)/SUM(capacity_mu)*100.
common_columns.paf_pct: Plant Availability Factor % for this row = declared_capacity_mu / capacity_mu x 100. Never AVG or SUM across rows.
common_columns.plf_with_nld_pct: PLF including deemed generation % = (gross + deemed) / capacity x 100. Never AVG across rows.
common_columns.aux_pct: Auxiliary consumption % = aux / gross x 100. Never AVG across rows.
common_columns.sp_coal_kg_kwh: Specific coal consumption kg/kWh = coal tonnes / 1000 / gross MU. Never AVG across rows.
common_columns.sp_oil_ml_kwh: Specific oil consumption ml/kWh = (HFO + LDO kL) / gross MU. Never AVG across rows.
common_columns.wa_gcv_coal_kcal_kg: Coal-weighted average GCV for this row, kcal/kg. Never AVG across rows.
common_columns.wa_gross_heat_rate_kcal_kwh: Generation-weighted average gross heat rate for this row, kcal/kWh. Never AVG across rows.
common_columns.cea_target_achievement_pct: Gross generation as % of the CEA target for this row. Never AVG across rows.
common_columns.reason_code: Reason code (outage reasons and back-down reasons are different lists).
common_columns.supplier_code: Coal supplier: MCL, SCCL, WCL (domestic) or IMPORTED.
common_columns.reservoir_key: Reservoir id (1 LINGANAMAKKI, 2 TALAKALALE, 3 SUPA, 4 MANI, 5 GERUSOPPA, 6 ALAMATTI).
common_columns.reservoir_name: Reservoir / dam name in upper case.
common_columns.level_unit: Unit of water_level for this reservoir: 'FT' (feet) or 'M' (metres).
common_columns.feeds_stations: Hydro stations this reservoir feeds, comma separated station keys.
common_columns.energy_at_frl_mu: Energy potential when full, MU (NULL where not known).

mart_dim_date.grain: one row per calendar day, 01-Apr-2015 to 30-Apr-2025
mart_dim_date.doc: Calendar. Facts already carry fy / month_label / water_year / season, so join this only for week or day-name questions.

mart_dim_station.doc: Stations with name, company, category and capacity. station_key is the code used in every fact.

columns.station_name: Full station name, e.g. 'Raichur Thermal Power Station'.
columns.company_code: Owning company: KPCL, RPCL (Raichur Power Corporation, owns YTPS) or KPCGPCL (KPCL Gas Power Corporation, owns YCCPP).
columns.plant_category_code: Category code (WTE is shown as RES on the dashboard).
columns.category_order: Display order of the category on the HO dashboard.
columns.commissioning_date: Station commissioning date (approximate for many hydro stations).
columns.report_order: Row order of the station on the HO Daily Generation Report.
columns.unit_count: Number of units at the station.
columns.fed_by_reservoirs: Reservoirs feeding this station, comma separated.

mart_dim_unit.doc: Units with capacity, fuel, technology, commissioning and life-to-date opening balances (RTPS only).

columns.fuel_code: COAL, GAS, MSW, WATER, WIND or SUN.
columns.technology: SUBCRITICAL, SUPERCRITICAL, CCGT, WTE, FRANCIS, WTG or PV.
columns.design_heat_rate_kcal_kwh: Design gross heat rate, kcal/kWh (thermal only).
columns.opening_balance_date: Date the opening cumulative figures are 'as on' (31-Mar-2015, RTPS units only).
columns.opening_cum_gen_mu: Cumulative generation since first synchronisation up to opening_balance_date, MU (RTPS only).
columns.opening_cum_running_hrs: Cumulative running hours up to opening_balance_date (RTPS only).
columns.opening_cum_trips: Cumulative trips up to opening_balance_date (RTPS only).

mart_dim_reservoir.doc: Reservoirs with FRL, MDDL, level unit and the stations they feed.

mart_dim_outage_reason.grain: one row per reason code (14 outage + 9 back-down)
mart_dim_outage_reason.doc: Lookup of reason codes. reason_class = 'OUTAGE' (used by mart_fact_unit_outage) or 'BACKDOWN' (used by mart_fact_generation_loss_daily). The facts already carry reason_description, so this is rarely needed; if you join it, filter reason_class.

columns.plant_type_code: Plant type the outage reason applies to (NULL = all types).

mart_dim_btf_type.doc: Boiler tube failure root causes, e.g. EROSION_SOOT_BLOWER, WELD_DEFECT.

mart_dim_btf_location.doc: Boiler tube failure locations, e.g. WATER_WALL, RE_HEATER, SUPER_HEATER.

mart_fact_unit_generation_daily.grain: one row per unit per day (365,132 rows)
mart_fact_unit_generation_daily.doc: Base generation fact: every parameter of the station Daily Generation Report per unit. Use for single-day questions, unit-level detail, water-year and season totals. Ratios are NOT stored here: compute SUM(gross_gen_mu)/SUM(capacity_mu)*100 for PLF etc. For a station total filter station_key and SUM over its units.

mart_fact_unit_generation_monthly.grain: one row per unit per month
mart_fact_unit_generation_monthly.doc: Unit Monthly Performance Report (MPR): monthly totals, targets and ratios pre-computed for that unit-month. Use for unit-month and unit-FY questions (SUM months with a fy filter).

columns.peak_load_mw: Highest daily peak load of the unit in the month, MW.

mart_fact_station_generation_daily.grain: one row per station per day
mart_fact_station_generation_daily.doc: HO Daily Generation Report at station level: units summed per day, with that day's PLF / PAF / aux %. Use for station-day questions, highest-day questions and KPCL daily totals (SUM over stations).

mart_fact_station_generation_monthly.grain: one row per station per month
mart_fact_station_generation_monthly.doc: Station Monthly Performance Report with CEA and internal targets and ratios pre-computed for that station-month. Use for station-month, quarter (SUM months of one fy_quarter) and category/KPCL monthly totals.

mart_fact_station_generation_fy.grain: one row per station per financial year
mart_fact_station_generation_fy.doc: Station totals per financial year with ratios pre-computed for that station-FY. Use for 'FY', 'this FY vs last FY', year-on-year and 'top stations by annual generation' questions. FY 2025-26 covers April 2025 only (is_partial_period = 1).

mart_fact_unit_outage.grain: one row per trip / shutdown event (5,877 rows)
mart_fact_unit_outage.doc: Every forced, planned or reserve-shutdown outage of a unit, with reason and boiler-tube-failure details. The event is dated by its trip day (date_key, fy, month_label); its hours are not split across months. Count events with COUNT(*); total hours with SUM(outage_hrs).

columns.date_key: Date the unit tripped / was taken out.
columns.outage_type: 'FORCED', 'PLANNED' or 'RSD' (reserve shut-down). 'Trips' usually means FORCED outages.
columns.trip_at: Timestamp the unit tripped / was taken out.
columns.sync_at: Timestamp the unit was re-synchronised; NULL = still out at the end of the data.
columns.is_open: 1 when the unit was still out at the end of the data (30-Apr-2025).
columns.outage_hrs: Duration in hours; for open outages, hours from trip to the end of the data (30-Apr-2025 24:00).
columns.gen_loss_mu: Generation lost during the outage, MU.
columns.is_structural: 1 for long-term shutdowns (RTPS-U1 since 10-Aug-2022, RTPS-U4 since 09-Nov-2024, SIRWAR-U1 since 01-Jun-2023).
columns.is_btf: 1 for a boiler tube failure / leak (BTF / BTL).
columns.btf_type_code: Boiler tube failure type code (BTF only).
columns.btf_location_code: Boiler tube failure location code (BTF only).

mart_fact_generation_loss_daily.grain: one row per unit per day per back-down reason (185,988 rows)
mart_fact_generation_loss_daily.doc: 'Reasons for back-down generation': MU of generation foregone while running, by reason. Thermal and gas stations only (RTPS, BTPS, YTPS, YCCPP). NO_LOAD_DEMAND rows are also the source of deemed_gen_mu (NLD).

columns.loss_mu: Generation lost to this reason that day, MU.

mart_fact_generation_target_monthly.grain: one row per unit per month
mart_fact_generation_target_monthly.doc: Monthly generation targets per unit. KERC-approved targets are not in the data. The station monthly and FY facts already carry these targets summed.

columns.date_key: First day of the target month.

mart_fact_coal_stock_daily.grain: one row per coal station per day (RTPS, BTPS, YTPS)
mart_fact_coal_stock_daily.doc: Daily coal stock balance: closing = opening + receipt - consumed. 'Below norm' = days_of_stock < normative_days.

columns.receipt_mt: Coal received that day (all suppliers), tonnes. For receipts by supplier or imported vs domestic use mart_fact_coal_receipt.
columns.indigenous_consumed_mt: Domestic coal consumed (burnt) that day, tonnes. Not receipts: coal received is mart_fact_coal_receipt.
columns.imported_consumed_mt: Imported coal consumed (burnt) that day, tonnes. Not receipts: imported coal received is mart_fact_coal_receipt WHERE is_imported = 1.
columns.closing_stock_mt: Closing stock, tonnes (a balance: never sum across days).
columns.days_of_stock: Days of consumption the closing stock covers (a level: never sum across days).
columns.normative_days: Normative days of stock the station should hold (20).

mart_fact_coal_receipt.grain: one row per rake delivery (22,300 rows)
mart_fact_coal_receipt.doc: Coal received per station per day by supplier. Weighted GCV = SUM(gcv_x_quantity_mt) / SUM(quantity_mt); never AVG(gcv_received_kcal_kg).

mart_fact_reservoir_daily.grain: one row per reservoir per day
mart_fact_reservoir_daily.doc: Daily dam level, storage %, inflow, discharge, spill, rainfall and energy potential. water_level is in the row's level_unit (FT or M); never compare levels across reservoirs. Levels and storage % are balances: never sum across days.

columns.level_above_mddl: Water level minus MDDL, in level_unit.
columns.discharge_power_mcft: Water discharged for power generation, million cubic feet.
columns.spill_sluice_mcft: Water spilled / sluiced, million cubic feet.
columns.energy_potential_mu: Energy the stored water can generate, MU (NULL for TALAKALALE, GERUSOPPA, ALAMATTI).

mart_fact_grid_daily.grain: one row per day (Karnataka state grid)
mart_fact_grid_daily.doc: State grid figures entered at Head Office, with KPCL's own gross generation for the day alongside. KPCL share over a period = SUM(kpcl_gross_gen_mu) / SUM(state_consumption_mu) x 100.

columns.kpcl_gross_gen_mu: KPCL gross generation that day (all stations), MU.
columns.kpcl_share_of_consumption_pct: KPCL gross generation as % of state consumption that day. Never AVG across days.

mart_fact_unit_current_status.grain: one row per unit, as of the end of the data (30-Apr-2025)
mart_fact_unit_current_status.doc: Unit status at the end of the data: RUNNING, FORCED_OUTAGE, PLANNED_OUTAGE, RSD_OUTAGE or DECOMMISSIONED, and since when. 'Now' / 'currently' means 30-Apr-2025. Not history: has no fy or month columns.

columns.status: RUNNING, FORCED_OUTAGE, PLANNED_OUTAGE, RSD_OUTAGE or DECOMMISSIONED.
columns.status_since: When the current status began (trip time, last re-synchronisation, or commissioning).
columns.days_in_status: Days out of service up to the end of the data (NULL when running).
columns.reason_detail: Recorded reason of the current outage.

mart_fact_unit_cumulative.doc: Life-to-date generation, running hours and trips since first synchronisation = opening balance (31-Mar-2015) + all later daily data. Only RTPS units have an opening balance; other units are NULL.

columns.opening_balance_date: Date of the opening balance (RTPS only).
columns.cum_gen_mu: Cumulative generation since first synchronisation, MU.

PLF.plain: Plant Load Factor: the energy a plant actually generated as a percentage of what it could have generated running at full capacity all the time.

PAF.plain: Plant Availability Factor: the capacity the plant declared available as a percentage of its full capacity over the period.

NLD.plain: No-load demand: generation a thermal unit could have produced but was asked to back down because the grid did not need it. It is counted as 'deemed generation' in 'PLF with NLD'.

MU.plain: Million units: one million kilowatt-hours (kWh) of energy. Generation figures are in MU.

Auxiliary consumption.plain: Electricity a station uses itself to run its equipment (pumps, fans, mills). Net export = gross generation minus auxiliary consumption.

Net export.plain: Energy actually sent out to the grid: gross generation minus the station's own auxiliary consumption.

Specific coal consumption.plain: Kilograms of coal burnt for each kWh generated.

Specific oil consumption.plain: Millilitres of fuel oil (HFO + LDO) used for each kWh generated, mostly for start-ups and flame support.

Heat rate.plain: Heat energy (kcal) needed to generate one kWh. Lower is more efficient.

GCV.plain: Gross calorific value: the heat energy in a kilogram of coal (kcal/kg).

RSD.plain: Reserve shut-down: the unit is available but switched off because it is not needed.

Forced outage.plain: An unplanned shutdown of a unit because of a fault (a 'trip').

Planned outage.plain: A scheduled shutdown for maintenance or overhaul.

BTF.plain: Boiler tube failure (or leak): a burst or leaking boiler tube that forces a thermal unit out of service.

Back-down.plain: Running a unit below its capability because of coal quality, equipment limits, low demand or similar reasons; the generation foregone is recorded by reason.

CEA target.plain: The monthly generation target set for each unit by the Central Electricity Authority.

Water year.plain: The hydro accounting year from June to May.

Financial year.plain: The accounting year from April to March, written like 2024-25.

MPR.plain: Monthly Performance Report: a station's monthly generation, availability, fuel and efficiency figures.

JMR.plain: Joint Meter Reading: the monthly meter statement signed by KPTCL, the ESCOM and KPCL for billing. It is not loaded in this data.

MDDL.plain: Minimum draw-down level: the lowest level a reservoir may be drawn down to.

FRL.plain: Full reservoir level: the level of a full dam.

ESCOM.plain: Electricity supply companies that buy KPCL's power: BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM and GESCOM. Billing data is not loaded in this data.

RES.plain: On the HO dashboard, RES is the waste-to-energy plant (Bidadi, BWTEP).

rules: Query only mart_* tables. They are SQLite tables; dates are text 'YYYY-MM-DD', fy is text like '2024-25', month_label is text like 'MAR-2025' (upper case).

Ratios (PLF, PAF, aux %, specific coal/oil, weighted GCV, heat rate, target achievement, KPCL share) must be computed as SUM(numerator)/SUM(denominator) over the rows in scope. Never AVG or SUM a *_pct, sp_*, wa_*, gcv_* or heat-rate column across rows. A pre-computed ratio column may be read as-is only for a single row of its own grain.

PLF = SUM(gross_gen_mu)/SUM(capacity_mu)*100. PAF = SUM(declared_capacity_mu)/SUM(capacity_mu)*100. PLF with NLD = SUM(gross_gen_mu+deemed_gen_mu)/SUM(capacity_mu)*100. Aux % = SUM(aux_consumption_mu)/SUM(gross_gen_mu)*100. Specific coal = SUM(coal_consumed_mt)/1000.0/SUM(gross_gen_mu). Specific oil = SUM(COALESCE(hfo_consumed_kl,0)+COALESCE(ldo_consumed_kl,0))/SUM(gross_gen_mu).

Choose the fact at the grain of the question: a day -> *_daily; a month or quarter -> *_monthly (fy_quarter needs a fy filter); a financial year -> mart_fact_station_generation_fy (station) or unit monthly summed over the fy; a water year or season -> *_daily with water_year / season. Never join two different generation facts in one aggregate (they would double count); use UNION ALL for side-by-side comparisons.
Station, category and KPCL totals: filter station_key, plant_category_label, or nothing (all 33 stations). A station total is the SUM over its units; never add a station row to its unit rows.

The data runs from 01-Apr-2015 to 30-Apr-2025. 'Today', 'now', 'currently', 'latest' mean 30-Apr-2025; 'this FY' = 2025-26 (April 2025 only, partial); 'last FY' = 2024-25 (the latest complete FY); 'this month' = APR-2025; 'last month' = MAR-2025.
Balances and levels (closing_stock_mt, days_of_stock, water_level, capacity_pct, level_above_mddl) must never be summed across days; take the value on a date, or MIN/MAX/AVG over a period.
Rankings: exclude NULL values (WHERE x IS NOT NULL) and use ORDER BY ... LIMIT. Units RTPS-U1, RTPS-U4 and SIRWAR-U1 are in long-term shutdown and generate nothing; say so if they come out lowest.
SQLite integer division truncates: multiply by 1.0 (or use a REAL column) before dividing. There is no FROM dual. Use strftime / date() for date maths.
Give every selected column an alias with AS. Never select more than one row per entity unless the question asks for a breakdown or trend.
Water levels are in each reservoir's own unit (FT or M); do not compare levels across reservoirs, compare capacity_pct instead.

Coal RECEIVED / delivered / arrived / rakes / supplier questions use mart_fact_coal_receipt (is_imported = 1 for imported coal). Coal CONSUMED / burnt / used questions use coal_consumed_mt in the generation facts or *_consumed_mt in mart_fact_coal_stock_daily.
Conditions on aggregates (SUM, COUNT, AVG ...) go in HAVING, never in WHERE. To leave out units that generated nothing in a period, GROUP BY the unit and add HAVING SUM(gross_gen_mu) > 0.
Name stations by station_key (e.g. 'SGS'); join mart_dim_station only when the full name is asked for.

'KPCL', 'KPCL total', 'the company' and 'all stations' mean ALL 33 stations in this data, including YTPS (company_code RPCL, a KPCL subsidiary) and YCCPP (company_code KPCGPCL, a KPCL subsidiary). Never filter on company_code unless the question names RPCL, KPCGPCL or a subsidiary.

Coverage: every table except the as-on snapshots has data for EVERY financial year FY 2015-16 to FY 2024-25 in full, plus April 2025 (FY 2025-26). A date between 01-Apr-2015 and 30-Apr-2025 or a year between 2015-16 and 2024-25 is always inside the data: write the SQL, never say it is outside the range.

A month, quarter, FY or water year asked for as one figure ('state consumption in March 2025', 'generation in FY 2023-24') is ONE total over that period (SUM for flows; MAX, MIN, AVG or the last day's value for levels), not one row per day, unless the question says daily, each day or day by day.

Coal suppliers: MCL = Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd, SCCL = Singareni Collieries Company Ltd, WCL = Western Coalfields Ltd, IMPORTED = imported coal. Filter mart_fact_coal_receipt on supplier_code with these codes.

Reservoir levels are in each reservoir's own unit (level_unit 'FT' feet or 'M' metres); always state that unit and never assume metres. Name alias columns after the measure (water_level), never after a unit (water_level_m).
Unit counts and installed capacity come from mart_dim_unit / mart_dim_station with no company filter: KPCL has 103 units and 33 stations.
SELECT only the columns the question needs (usually 2 to 6), each aliased once. Never list every column of a table.
